categories.main_business_segments: Puyuan Jingdian Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic measurement instruments industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of general electronic measurement instruments including digital oscilloscopes, RF instruments, waveform generators, power supplies and electronic loads, multimeters, and data acquisition devices. The company also provides related technical and after-sales services, as well as computer software and hardware sales. It has expanded into modular instruments and integrated solutions, aiming to transform from a hardware-centric supplier to a comprehensive solutions provider.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes original technology innovation with proprietary core technologies in hardware, algorithms, and software. Key technologies include high-bandwidth, high-integration analog front-end chips, high sampling rate signal processing chips, low-noise analog front-end technology, high refresh rate display algorithms, and modular hardware platforms. Production methods combine in-house manufacturing of core components with outsourced non-critical parts, supported by advanced ERP, MES, and WMS systems for supply chain and production management. The company also employs lean manufacturing and automation technologies such as AGV and robotic assembly lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Puyuan Jingdian serves a diverse customer base across industries such as telecommunications, new energy, semiconductors, consumer electronics, industrial electronics, transportation and energy, education and scientific research, and system integration. Its products support scientific research, product development, and manufacturing testing needs. The company’s solutions cater to strategic emerging industries including 5G, AI, IoT, semiconductor testing, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with headquarters in Suzhou, China, and R&D centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, and overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Malaysia, and marketing representatives in India, Brazil, and Vietnam. Its products are sold in over 90 countries and regions worldwide, with significant sales in domestic China and international markets including North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: Puyuan Jingdian operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electronic measurement instrument supply chain. It focuses on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of electronic measurement instruments and solutions, controlling core production processes such as packaging, testing, software programming, and assembly internally, while outsourcing non-core components. The company manages a global supply chain with strategic supplier relationships and employs MRP and JIT procurement methods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on original technology innovation and market-driven R&D, emphasizing breakthroughs in integrated circuit design, composite material processes, advanced manufacturing, and core hardware, algorithm, and software technologies. It targets high-growth sectors such as communications, semiconductors, and new energy. R&D initiatives include development of high-bandwidth digital oscilloscopes, high-resolution waveform generators, modular instruments, and integrated solutions. The company also invests heavily in intellectual property and collaborates with universities and industry partners to foster innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electronic measurement instruments and related solutions. The company employs a combined sales model of direct sales, distributor sales, and e-commerce platforms. It also generates revenue from after-sales services and customized solutions. The company’s sales are recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with some revenue from service contracts recognized over time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Puyuan Jingdian is positioned as a leading domestic player in China and ranks fifth globally in the digital oscilloscope market, being the only Chinese company in the global top five. It competes with international companies from the US, Germany, and Japan, and holds a strong position in high-end digital oscilloscopes, waveform generators, and RF instruments. The company differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product portfolios, and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 776 million, representing a 15.7% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 92.3 million, with a slight decline compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.85 billion, growing nearly 18% from the prior year. R&D investment accounted for 26.64% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory supported by increased innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Puyuan Jingdian emphasizes original technology innovation, high performance, and reliability in its electronic measurement instruments. Its products feature advanced core technologies such as high bandwidth, high sampling rates, and low noise, achieving domestic leadership and international competitiveness. The company offers multi-level solutions from chip-level to system-level, supporting complex testing challenges in strategic emerging industries. Its global brand 'RIGOL' is recognized for quality, innovation, and comprehensive customer support.
